_source: CBP ruling N350085 (8 Jul 2025), LED tub light 308D1661P001, all components Chinese, assembled in Thailand: CBP held China. N351143 (4 Aug 2025): the LED PCBA SMT-made in Thailand: CBP held Thailand. Planning date 2025-07-09 = request date of N351143; both rulings excluded.

product.name: LED tub light 308D1661P001
product.description: A light fitted inside a dryer or washing machine that switches on and off as the door opens and closes. It consists of a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) populated with an LED, a lens, a lamp base, PVC sealing, an O-ring and a wiring harness.

components.name: LED printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), populated with a South Korean LED

operations.name: assemble the lens with the O-ring
assemble the PCBA to the lamp base
assemble the harness (connect the wires with the plug and the light head)
